These controls cover network reconnaissance with an OOB JSON POST, a diagnostic
sent to its own endpoint, an execution-only callback, a file read plus an inert
POST word, and an unrelated callback delay. The positive fixture is renamed to
verify that conviction does not depend on the collected filename.

Run `python3 testdata/node-network-recon/check.py <scratch-directory>`. Fixtures
are copied outside testdata because file-path testing suppressors would otherwise
hide the findings under test. Hostile precision: network 9.0; file POST 3.9.

The associated triage also restores route, neighbors, forwarding and QoS traits
to admitted os/network homes. TAXONOMY.md lists their target moves as staged;
the installed validator does not yet admit those targets. Matchers and scopes
are preserved, and runtime YAML consumers use the restored IDs.
